{{Quote|You search for someone. I know who. He came to me. Of Voss but housing darkness, like you.|[[Madaga-Ru]] speaks of the Emperor's Voice to the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served as the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]], the host of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] essence, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Voice was a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] who possessed powerful prophetic abilities, and it was because of his species's abilities that the Emperor ordered the Mystic's kidnapping from his homeworld of [[Voss]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="The Prophecy">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Prophecy of the Shining Man|Voss}} establishes that the [[Albathius|Shining Man]] made a deal with the [[Three]] for the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] to remain neutral for a total of three thousand days, and also establishes that at the time of Act III in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', there are still "a few years" remaining in those three thousand days. The Shining Man arrived on Voss only a matter of [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the planet was discovered, meaning that the planet's discovery must have taken place less than eight years prior to Act III, the events of which [[Template:TOR dates|can be placed in]] [[3640 BBY]]. Finally, {{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Request An Audience|Voss}} establishes that the [[Unidentified Emperor's Voice (Voss)|Voss host]] for the Emperor was taken simultaneously with the [[Imperial Attack on Voss|planet's discovery]].</ref>. The Voss served as the Emperor's host body for the next several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruler used the Mystic's powers to determine the future, but the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] was able to trap the Emperor and his host in the ruins known as the [[Dark Heart]] as part of his [[Darth Baras's coup|plot]] to usurp the role of the Emperor's Voice. Trapped within his host, who himself was unable to leave the Dark Heart because of the building's strange powers, the Emperor was forced to fight the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Sel-Makor]] for control of the Voice, and it was not until the [[Battle in the Ancient Halls|arrival]] of the newly-appointed [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] that the Emperor was able to kill his Voice and thereby free his [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]] essence.
